configuration.title: Notify me
configuration.description: Meetings you are invited to, and every event on your own calendars. A calendar's ✎ changes which it is. A hidden calendar reminds too.

send-test.description: Shows a notification now, to see that macOS lets it through. Answers what came of it, as text.

go-to-date.description: Shows a day in the view on screen.

show-view.description: Shows the day, the week or the month view.
